mapper.select: select sku.f_id as skuId, sku.spu_id as spuId, sku.goods_spec_id as goodsSpecId, sku.sku_code as skuCode, sku.sku_spec_name as skuSpecName, gsr.original_price as originalPrice from goods_sku sku left join goods_spec_relation gsr on sku.goods_spec_id = gsr.f_id where (sku.f_delete_mark = 0 or sku.f_delete_mark is null) and (gsr.f_delete_mark = 0 or gsr.f_delete_mark is null) and sku.spu_id = #{spuId} order by sku.f_creator_time desc
select * from goods_sku where (f_delete_mark = 0 or f_delete_mark is null) and spu_id = #{spuId} order by f_creator_time desc

select sku.f_id as skuId, sku.spu_id as spuId, sku.goods_spec_id as goodsSpecId, sku.sku_code as skuCode, sku.sku_spec_name as skuSpecName, gsr.original_price as originalPrice from goods_sku sku left join goods_spec_relation gsr on sku.goods_spec_id = gsr.f_id where (sku.f_delete_mark = 0 or sku.f_delete_mark is null) and (gsr.f_delete_mark = 0 or gsr.f_delete_mark is null) order by sku.f_creator_time desc
